title: Stop a typed from freezing into a wrong sender pill

proofs.run: read the results file par-searchmac writes (_captures/results/par-searchmac/, or $WHOOSH_RESULTS_DIR, *.results.jsonl) and take the line of the case: it carries the expected [([], true, true)] x3 and the values read for 'email from consultant'

mutants.find: public static func typed(_ raw: String) -> SearchQuery { SearchQuery(raw, spokenFilters: false) }
mutants.replace: public static func typed(_ raw: String) -> SearchQuery { SearchQuery(raw + " from:c", spokenFilters: false) }

notes: Unit: Tests/Unit/SearchRankingTests.swift:212 (theWordFromInASentenceMakesNoChip: 'email from consultant' and 'email from c' make no chip, words stay words), :222 (the colon form still makes the chip, the positive control), :249 (theLaunchedQueryIsTheWordsTheFieldShows: the launched words equal the field's), :260. Code: Sources/Features/SearchMac/SearchQuery.swift:98-134 (only typed colon forms are pills; keywords from/before/has stay words until Tab), SearchMacModel.swift:128 (launchedQuery). Hidden case: checks/parity/par-searchmac.py:324 (name) and :487-496 (words_stay_words: 'email from consultant', 'from Linea Supply has attachment', 'price before June': no chip, the bar text and the core's search/last/query equal the typed text). par-searchmac prints no line for a passing case (main() :2486-2505), hence proof 2 (results file); the pass of proof 1 is shown by the case not appearing in the FAIL lines and the summary '0 failed, 0 not judged'. SPEC A142 (docs/SPEC.md:158).
